title: Data Analyst
description: Turn raw data into decisions: query databases, clean and explore datasets, and communicate findings with clear visualizations.

title: Data Scientist
description: Frame questions statistically, build and validate predictive models, and explain what the evidence does and does not support.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Ship machine learning systems: reliable training pipelines, rigorous evaluation, and models deployed and monitored in production.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build systems that understand and generate language, from classic text features to Transformer models.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Craft accessible, fast and maintainable interfaces with modern JavaScript, TypeScript and React.

title: Backend Developer
description: Design APIs and data models that are correct, secure and easy to operate.
